title: Server Unreachable
description: Cannot ping PROD-SRV-01 from NOC-MONITOR
resolution: Restarted network interface on PROD-SRV-01 via Ansible playbook restart_interface.yml. Root cause: VLAN misconfig in Azure.

title: Application Login Error
description: User reported login failed with error code 503 on CRM portal
resolution: Fixed application pool by recycling it through IIS Manager on PROD-CRM-01. Root cause: Out of memory.

title: Certificate Expiring Soon
description: Certificate for PROD-API-GATEWAY is set to expire in 3 days
resolution: Renewed certificate on PROD-API-GATEWAY via Azure Key Vault. Updated DNS record with new cert.

title: Database Replication Lag
description: SQL Server replication from DR site lags by 5 minutes
resolution: Synced logs and reinitialized replication on SQLDR-SVR-01. Root cause: Network latency between primary and secondary.

title: VPN Connection Down
description: Employee reports VPN connection from New York is down
resolution: Reconnected VPN tunnel via Azure P2S VPN client on PROD-NYC-WKS-01. Root cause: BGP flap.

title: AD Group Update
description: Manager requests addition of new group to HR department
resolution: Added AD group via Azure AD PowerShell script. Verified permissions in OKTA SSO.

title: API Gateway Timeout
description: Microservice is timing out when accessed through API gateway
resolution: Increased timeout settings on PROD-API-GW-01. Updated configuration file using Terraform.

title: Storage Array Failure
description: NAS array reports I/O errors on /data partition
resolution: Replaced faulty disk and reconfigured RAID阵列 via HashiCorp Vault. Verified data integrity.

title: Kubernetes Pod Down
description: Pod is unresponsive in production environment
resolution: Restarted pod via Kubernetes Dashboard. Root cause: Memory leak identified in application logs.

title: Security Alert
description: SOC team reports suspicious activity detected by CrowdStrike on PROD-SRV-05
resolution: Investigated alert and confirmed false positive. Updated detection rules via Splunk.

title: Database Query Performance
description: Slow query observed in production environment
resolution: Optimized query using EXPLAIN plan on PROD-SQL-SVR-02. Increased indexing.

title: Microservice Failure
description: Service is down after deployment of new version
resolution: Rolled back to previous version via GitOps. Deployed fix in next release.

title: Ransomware Indicators
description: SOC team reports potential ransomware on PROD-NAS-01
resolution: Isolated affected system and ran ransomware removal tool. Conducting forensic analysis.

title: Firewall Rule Request
description: Need new firewall rule for SaaS integration
resolution: Created new firewall rule via Azure Firewall Management Console. Confirmed with security team.

title: VPN Drop Incident

resolution: Removed AD group via Azure AD PowerShell script. Verified permissions in OKTA SSO.
